facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: pressure release during routine operation on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3222 and M-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during routine operation while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 30 January 2023 an incident occurred on P-3222 and M-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
